newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha gains on back of crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha gains on back of crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha was $2-3 a tonne stronger on Thursday, tracking closely gains in crude futures.
Dealers said activity was muted on the physical side and only marginally more interesting on swaps. Talk on February was at $221-$222 with March at $215.50-$216.50.
End-user petchem buying continues to look slow with most appearing covered and only bits and pieces of interest.

In the Mediterranean demand was seen towards early February, but the first Skikda cargoes are said already committed and freight costs are still high. Some Alexandria material was likely to become available over the next couple of weeks.
Freight rates have been high enough in the Med to limit business and prompt talk of bringing material in from the Gulf.
"There's been talk of doing this, but nothing seen yet," said one trader.
